paragraphs.text: Truly when I read your excellency's letter I felt unwonted pleasure and cheerfulness; and when I met your well-beloved sons, I seemed to behold yourself. They found me in the deepest affliction, but they so behaved as to make me forget the hemlock, which your dreamers and dream mongers are carrying about to my hurt, to please the people who have hired them. Some letters I have already sent; others, if you like, shall follow. I only hope that they may be of some advantage to the recipients.

latex.p0004: 确实，当我读到阁下之信时，我感到异乎寻常的喜悦与欢愉；当我遇到您可爱的儿子们时，我仿佛看到了您本人。他们见我处于极大的痛苦中，但他们的举止使我忘记了毒芹——那是您那些梦想家和兜售梦想者为了讨好雇用他们的人而四处散布以伤害我的。有些信我已寄出；其余的，若您愿意，随后送上。我只希望它们对收信人有所裨益。
